ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.20; a predominant low-intensity (black) surface with concentrated high-intensity (white) regions on the left lobe and scattered high-intensity points across the right.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity region (mottling) located on the upper-distal quadrant of the left lobe; numerous discrete sub-10px high-intensity spots (blobs) distributed sparsely across the central and medial regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 75-degree V-shaped vertex; depth is roughly 12% of the total vertical height of the visible lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular peaks and valleys across the entire trailing boundary; peak-to-valley amplitude is most pronounced on the distal 25% of both lobes, reaching up to 20 pixels in height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve sweeping from the medial notch to the distal tips, with a distinct upward convex rotation at the outer lateral terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense cluster of roughly circular high-intensity pixel groups on the right distal tip (consistent with barnacle attachment); smaller, lower-density clusters present on the left distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple parallel, diagonal high-intensity streaks (rake marks) on the mid-to-lower right lobe; several isolated horizontal linear marks on the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent calcified structural accumulation (barnacle colony) on the right fluke tip; extensive white pigmentation scarring on the upper portion of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct group of three parallel linear scars on the lower right quadrant of the fluke surface.
